newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keisei Electric hits low for year.
newsitem.headline: Keisei Electric hits low for year.

text.p: Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd shares hit a new low for the year in early Tuesday morning trade.
As of 0039 GMT, the shares were down 10 yen at 761 yen, the sixth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse in a volume of 2.031 million.
The firm's shares had been bought recently on the listing of Oriental Land Co Ltd, as Keisei is a major shareholder in the operator of Tokyo Disneyland.
But the weakness of Oriental Land shares discouraged Keisei shareholders, tempting them to sell, traders said.
Oriental Land Co Ltd shares sank below the 8,000 yen line in early Tuesday morning trade, hitting another record low. The shares were down 180 yen at 7,950 yen.
